title: TachoGo — EU 561/2006 driving and rest time for drivers
description: Driving and rest timers under EU Regulation 561/2006 and the AETR: 45-minute break, end of shift, weekly rest, log, report and truck driving bans. Android, no ads.
lead: Driving and rest time under EU rules — for trucks, buses and 2.5–3.5 t vans. See at a glance how much time is left until your break, the end of your shift and your weekly rest, and get a warning in advance.
screen_text: The home screen answers one question: how much longer can you drive. The other limits are below, each with the time it runs out.
f1_text: A 45-minute break or 15 + 30, 9 or 10 hours a day, 56 a week, 90 in two weeks, a working day of 13 and 15 hours.
f2_text: 15, 30 or 60 minutes before your break and the end of the working day. Even when the app is closed.
f3_text: Daily rest of 11 hours, reduced 9, split 3 + 9. Weekly rest of 45 or 24 hours, compensation owed and its deadline.
f4_text: History by weeks, countries where each shift starts and ends. PDF or CSV for a week, 28 or 56 days — in the language of the country where you are checked.
f5_text: Optional. You move off — “Driving”; you stand still for 3 minutes — “Other work”. Your location is not stored.
f6_text: Works offline, no account, no ads. 14 languages and large buttons — easy to use with gloves.
vans_text: International transport by van now also falls under 561/2006. TachoGo checks whether the rules apply to your vehicle.
bans_rules: General bans — the app counts the times
bans_text: Where a ban applies now and today. Weekends, public holidays and summer bans — in each country’s local time. Rules are checked once a day; offline, the last downloaded rules apply.
free_text: Activities, all timers and warnings, “End day”, the log, today’s bans.
premium_text: Editing the log, PDF and CSV reports, moving to another phone, the ban calendar.
a1: No. The app helps you plan your time, but it is not an official record. At a roadside check, the tachograph and driver card data apply.
a2: No. Everything stays on your phone, no account needed. The internet is only used to update the driving ban rules.
a3: Android only for now. The iPhone version will follow after the release.
q4: How do I join the beta?
a4: Write to us from the Google account you use on your phone — we will send you an invitation to Google Play.
